summary: RETEST after iteration-2 blockers: all previously-missing endpoints are now implemented and verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 30/30 pass in serial mode (test_krishiva_backend.py). GET /api/subscriptions/plans returns razorpay_configured=false + monthly (₹99, 9900 paise, 31d) + yearly (₹999, 99900 paise, 365d). Full chunked media flow verified: POST /media/start -> 2x /chunk (95B + 95B base64-encoded) -> /finish -> GET /media/{id} returns 190 bytes; Range: bytes=0-99 returns 206 with 'Content-Range: bytes 0-99/190' and 100-byte body. Frontend E2E on 390x800 web preview: logged in as meera@krishiva.in / test1234 (login testID is `login-email`, not `login-identifier`) -> tapped FAB (+) -> /subscribe rendered ₹99 + ₹999 plan cards + 'Test mode' banner + 'Activate Yearly (Test Mode)' button (NO infinite loader) -> selected Monthly -> button text switched to 'Activate Monthly (Test Mode)' -> tapped -> 'Welcome to Krishiva Plus! 🌱' success screen -> 'Start exploring' returned to feed. Tapped FAB again -> /create-post opened (all 4 attach buttons Camera/Record/Photo/Video visible + testID `tag-waste` chip labeled '♻️ Waste Management') -> submitted text post 'TEST_MEERA verification post via Playwright' with category tag-waste -> Post button pressed -> returned to feed -> after reload the new post appears at top of feed with 'Waste Management' pill and the 'Join Plus' header pill is gone (Meera is now Plus). Profile tab shows testID `plus-active-card` ('Krishiva Plus active — Valid till 9/7/2026') beside Edit profile + Log out; no Join Plus CTA. On Suresh Yadav's /user/{id} page, testID `follow-user` toggled 'Follow' -> 'Following' and Followers count incremented 0 -> 1. Cleanup: reseeded via `cd /app/backend && python seed.py` at end so Meera is back to FREE. NOTE: pytest with default xdist -n auto has a race between the parallel worker that runs TestSubscriptionEndpoints.test_dev_activate_free_user (which flips Meera to Plus) and the worker running TestSubscriptionGating.test_free_user_*_403 — 3 tests fail when run in parallel because the fixture is session-scoped and both workers share Meera. Serial run passes 30/30. Recommend either (a) using --dist loadscope with class scoping in pytest.ini (already loadscope), or (b) making dev-activate test use a fresh throwaway user, or (c) restoring meera subscription in a teardown. Not a product bug.

minor.issue: pytest-xdist parallel run: TestSubscriptionEndpoints.test_dev_activate_free_user activates Meera to Plus in a parallel worker, causing TestSubscriptionGating.test_free_user_{post,message,follow}_403 to see 200 instead of 403. Serial run (`-p no:xdist -o addopts=`) passes 30/30. Fix by scoping dev-activate to a throwaway user or by teardown that clears meera.subscription.
